fields.name: root
fields.label: Root Path (Optional)
fields.description: Folder to pick articles from, e.g. /blogs/technology.

fields.name: index
fields.label: Query Index Path
fields.description: Index to read articles from, e.g. /news-index.json. Another site's index can be given as a full URL (e.g. https://www.jswmotors.com/news-index.json for a dealer site): its articles then link to that site. That site must allow this one to read it (CORS).

fields.name: show
fields.label: Show
fields.description: Current Page Tags: articles sharing this page's tags (the block is hidden when the page has no tags). Latest articles: the newest articles from the Root Path, whatever their tags.

fields.name: viewAll
fields.label: View All Link (Optional)
fields.description: Page the View all button opens, e.g. /newsroom. The button shows on the right of the heading only when this and the View All Label are both filled in.

fields.name: viewAllLabel
fields.label: View All Label (Optional)
fields.description: Text of the View all button, e.g. View all news. No button when empty.

fields.name: classes
fields.label: Style
fields.description: Center (default): the heading centred over the cards. Left: the eyebrow and heading on the left, then title and summary under each image. In both, the View all button sits on the right of the heading.
